limitations: Pinned catalogue and dated TCG snapshot are technical test inputs, not new official rulings.
Initial Main Deck fields and borrowed Spirit history are declared when explicitly noted; witnessed Azure qualification is created only by executed Synchro procedures.
Unknown material effects, level modifications, simultaneous trigger arrangements and general priority remain outside this registered subset.
Protection does not prevent battle damage, non-destruction removal or unknown rule interactions; competitive scoring remains provisional.

meaning: Passed local Node source cases from the preserved complete local run; remote whole-release acceptance is recorded separately through mandatory CI gates. These are not downloaded remote result files.
